direction.grid: 1366x768 full-screen command center: 48px header, 40px compact horizontal rail, minmax(0,1fr) main, 56px action bar; enlarge the cinematic rendered scene to at least 70% of main with independent reserved zones for callouts, stations and jobs and no overlap; condense side content inside its reserved zone; rail targets equal width, at least 36px high, non-wrapping, aria-current plus arrow-key movement
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22), silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) for secondary text, emerald/neon #A8F04A as sole accent with #050705 text on primary fill and only one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, a cross marker and plain OFFLINE text; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; large header tabs spanning most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Preserve living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions driven by real state: 160-220ms ease-out selection, one 240ms route trace on state change, then settle; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text retain meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo; compact horizontal rail only; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene with bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; side zone keeps connection readiness checking provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar with Back left, status centre, one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then the Authorize this decision wall; pending task proposals stay deliberately untracked until human approval and can coexist with blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG filling at least 70% of main: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend using glow, pattern, marker and text; depth via layered silver machine bodies, emerald route glow and moving flow only where real state is active

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory scene toward 70% of main and add layered machine depth plus emerald material flow from Receiving toward feasible cells.
Raise muted station and job body text to full 16px/24 and strengthen silver contrast without shrinking the scene.
Add a persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible legend linked to SVG nodes with focus ring and bidirectional highlighting.
Separate connection readiness for provider identity from the investigation evidence task with distinct headings, status and controls in the side zone.
Reduce the empty lower side panel by surfacing the three verified findings as compact evidence rows beside the scene.
Make verified, rejected and feasible counts scannable at 26px tabular size and link each count to its SVG evidence.
On selecting a path, show the one-click Approve action then the Authorize this decision wall as the clear next state.
Highlight only the selected feasible route in emerald across stations and jobs while keeping other routes dim silver.
Increase tradeoff finish and cost figures to stronger tabular hierarchy so comparison reads in three seconds.
Keep proposed tasks visibly UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL and visually distinct from tracked work with dashed silver borders.
Add depth and state glow to the task sequence so t1, t2 and t3 read as a living staged flow rather than flat cards.
Enlarge task titles and due details to 16px/24 within their reserved cards without adding side-zone scrolling.
Retain the strong cross-hatched preview for CELL-MILL-2 and add a plain OFFLINE label plus cross marker at full size before applying the shock.
Animate the capacity change 24h to 0h as one cinematic route fade on apply, with reduced-motion showing the static final state.
Make the invalidating consequence status in the action bar 16px and paired with the primary action.
Strengthen CELL-MILL-2 silver cross-hatching, cross marker and plain OFFLINE text and remove any route through it.
Separate provider identity readiness from this reinvestigation evidence task in the side zone instead of implying one control covers both.
Fill the empty findings zone with its awaiting-investigation state, expected outputs and keyboard-focusable evidence placeholders.
Make the constrained Split path read as unavailable through silver hatching, cross marker and plain reason text while keeping the two feasible paths selectable.
Glow only the currently reviewed revised route in the factory scene and dim non-feasible routes.
Raise the invalidated-acceptance status to equal visual weight with the revised primary action.
Keep 3 BLOCKED prior tasks and 3 PROPOSED replacements in clearly separated groups, with proposals untracked until approval.
Show CELL-MILL-2 as cross-hatched OFFLINE with cross marker in the station zone to match the prior shock state.
Add a subtle emerald progression flow from the approved revised plan into the proposed replacement sequence.
Give the 01-02-03 proof chain greater depth and state glow, with READY in emerald and LOCKED stages in dim silver.
Condense the dense side-zone passphrase guidance to one instruction and one status sentence at 16px/24.
Align the 70, 35h and 48h proof metrics as a clear before-after visual tied to the factory outcome.
Fix clipped department titles and overlapping machine labels; enlarge each department zone so names, counts and machine glyphs never collide.
Correct inconsistent offline counts and show stopped machines with silver cross-hatching, cross marker and plain OFFLINE text while running machines carry emerald flow and glow.
Add visible living cascade flow across departments driven by real state, with a cinematic department-to-department trace and reduced-motion static equivalent.
Enlarge the full-shop cascade visual and its caption type so department states and the emerald-to-silver failure wave are legible without zooming.
Tighten the hero visual crop so the headline and three benefit columns sit fully inside the frame with stronger contrast.
Make the Live demo link larger than body copy with a clear focus ring while preserving the fixed presentation order.
